title: Broncos sign rookie safety Miles Scott to a four-year deal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos sign rookie safety Miles Scott to a four-year deal
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Broncos insider Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos have signed rookie safety Miles Scott to a four-year deal. He joins rookies Justin Joly, Dallen Bentley, and Red Murdock as the Broncos’ rookies they have signed ahead of their rookie minicamp this weekend.
